WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
), shares AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count,
         1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM project_counts
), deviations AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref AS project, qc_count AS count, share, deviation
FROM deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
